verdict.rationale: Kong's own declarative configuration and decK tooling let a user define and apply many gateway entities from one config file, and the Terraform providers do the same across Gateway entities, control planes and Dev Portal. That amounts to bulk management. However, the evidence never describes explicit bulk or batch operations (e.g. bulk update or delete endpoints, multi-select actions) or how sync behaves at scale. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bulk/batch operations across many items, bulk API endpoints or CLI batch commands, and hands-on corroboration of bulk changes at scale.
